Run-rate anchor: FQ2 FY27 guide of $55-57 non-GAAP EPS on ~151M diluted shares (~$224 annualised). Cyclical memory multiple applied to near-peak earnings.

bear.driver: NAND pricing rolls over in 2027 as Kioxia flagged slowing price gains; non-contract bits reprice down and gross margin falls toward the ~80% floor management cites only for contracted volume, then below

base.driver: Pricing plateaus; ~2/3 of FY28 bits committed under long-term agreements keep earnings near but below the FQ2 run-rate; market keeps a peak-cycle multiple

bull.driver: AI datacenter SSD demand keeps supply tight through FY28; datacenter revenue (up 61% q/q in FQ1) keeps compounding and margins hold ~85%

valuation.implied_by_close: At the $885 close the stock trades at ~4.0x the ~$224 annualised FQ2 guide and ~4.7x base NTM EPS; the Street mean (~$2,047) implies ~9x the run-rate or ~$340 EPS at the base 6x.
valuation.sensitivity: One turn of P/E moves the base target by $190 (about 21 pp of return); $10 of NTM EPS moves it by $60 (about 7 pp).
valuation.watch_metric: Blended NAND average selling price and non-GAAP gross margin versus the 84.5-85.5% FQ2 guide; datacenter revenue growth.
valuation.next_disclosure: Fiscal Q2 2027 results, expected late January 2027.
